methods.note: Page 4 Eqs. 1-5 (Joule heating plus Fourier conduction) and page 5 (COMSOL, steady-state and transient, 50% duty cycle, NAND configuration) support the stated solver. The method is only partly specified: no mesh, solver tolerances, or time stepping are given, and Fig. 3 flow details are graphical. Nothing in the packet supports a 2D reproduction.

code.note: No code, COMSOL model file, or pinned asset exists. The only link is www.comsol.com (ref 27, page 8), a vendor site rather than a reproducible artifact. A bare URL is not evidence.

parameters.note: Text values check out against pages 3, 5 and 7: 183x145 nm^2, 16 nm channel, 50 nm ILV, 110 nm ILV length, 1.4 um z height, 600x300 nm^2 sink, 0.8/0.527/0.495 V, 300 K sink, 13 and 0.3 and 167 W/mK. Table I on page 4 has no extractable text and no image was supplied. The NMOS gate biases, per-block power or current, block dimensions, and material table are absent, so the parameter set is incomplete.

config.note: The boundary conditions (300 K sink bottom, adiabatic elsewhere) are stated in text. The M3D layer stack, material assignment per block, mesh, time-stepping, and block coordinates are not published. The extraction sets experiment.kind to custom_2d_steady with an empty floorplan, which is not a valid configuration for this paper.

data.note: No same-scenario power rows exist for any floorplan block and no floorplan blocks exist. Figs. 4-7 are graphical and no figure image was supplied for visual verification, so the 420 K peak was checked against text only. The 420 K (page 6) versus 450 K (page 2) conflict is unresolved. Transient numbers are unavailable.

findings.reason: The experiment is declared custom_2d_steady, yet the same extraction says steady_2d_relevant=false, the scenario is nanoscale 3-D, and the floorplan and power are empty. This is internally contradictory. A 2D reproduction cannot be called supported, because the decisive 3-D tier/ILV structure, the sink and boundary condition, and the transient behavior have no 2D equivalent.

No block coordinates, widths, or heights are published, and no per-block watts or currents appear anywhere. Any floorplan block would therefore lack same-scenario power. Only voltages are given, and the NMOS (top-tier) gate biases are not stated at all.
findings.locator: PDF p.4 Table I (no text); PDF p.5 Grain Boundary Condition Modeling

findings.reason: The extraction labels 420 K a 'steady-state' peak, but the text never states that Fig. 4 is steady-state. No figure image was supplied, so the Fig. 4A-B temperature field and its max-versus-region definition were not visually verified. The 450 K figure on page 2 conflicts with 420 K and remains unresolved.
findings.locator: PDF p.6 Sec. V.A; PDF p.2 intro; Fig. 4 (PDF p.5)

findings.reason: The extraction says the 0.3 W/mK dielectric is 'not the no-medium baseline Fig. 4'. The paper never explicitly says Fig. 4 excludes the dielectric medium. This is an inference, so the scenario match to Fig. 4 versus Fig. 5A is unresolved.
The 13 W/mK value is stated in the context of the Skybridge single-nanowire stack. Applicability to the M3D scenario is unsupported, and no M3D material table (Table I) is readable.
findings.locator: PDF p.5 Geometry Modeling; PDF p.4 Table I

findings.reason: The 0.527/0.495 V values are given jointly for the M3D and SN3D combinational styles. The assignment of each voltage to a specific M3D transistor, and the NMOS biases, are not given.
findings.locator: PDF p.5 Grain Boundary Condition Modeling

findings.reason: The wording '50% duty cycle of 100ns time' is ambiguous (period versus simulated time). No published power or temperature time series exists to resolve it. The transient figures (Figs. 6-7) were not visually verified and no digitization is provided.
findings.locator: PDF p.5 top; PDF p.7 Figs. 6-7

findings.reason: The status 'checked_links_found' overstates the situation. The only link is the COMSOL commercial site, which is not an artifact. No assets are pinned, so code, config, and data are unsupported.

The 'centimeter-scale 2D floorplan with watt-level block power' and 'Studio runner' claims describe a Studio target that is not defined in the packet. These are unsupported assumptions, though they do not change the conclusion that the scenario is not 2D.

The paper says the Skybridge 650 K peak is 'almost 250K rise', but 650 K over 300 K is a 350 K rise. The abstract's '100K-200K' also conflicts. The paper's own observable numbers are unreliable and should be flagged before use as a benchmark.
findings.locator: PDF p.6 Sec. V.A; PDF p.1 abstract; PDF p.2
